One row per RFC that the [RFC Editor's index](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc-index.xml) lists as plain text or RFCXML, read in bulk at stage S2: its index metadata and how many BCP 14 requirements the mechanical extraction finds in it, by level, counted in its RFCXML where the index lists one, else in its plain text. Nothing here is reviewed. Source names the format read, linked to the RFC Editor file the counts came from; Obsoleted by and Updated by link each RFC that has a row; Requirements reads `none` when the extraction finds no BCP 14 keyword; Profile names each profile of the [protocol catalogue](/docs/catalog) whose lock holds the RFC, linked to its page, where its requirements are reviewed.
